name: Mega Snake: 16-Bit Edition
storyline:
In a world inspired by the golden era of arcade gaming, one hungry snake begins an endless quest for the highest score. Every glowing pellet makes it longer, every turn becomes more dangerous, and every second survived pushes your reflexes to the limit.

Navigate an ever-growing snake through a challenging grid, avoid walls and your own tail, and adapt as the pace steadily increases. There are no shortcuts or power-ups—only skill, precision, and the determination to survive longer than ever before.

How long can you keep the Mega Snake alive?
summary:
Relive the golden age of arcade gaming with Mega Snake: 16-Bit Edition, a retro-inspired arcade snake game featuring vibrant 16-bit visuals, responsive controls, and classic high-score gameplay.

Guide your snake through an endless grid, collect pellets to grow longer, avoid walls, obstacles, and your own tail, and survive as the speed steadily increases. Whether playing with a keyboard, gamepad, or touch controls, every run is a new challenge to beat your best score.

Designed for modern PCs and Xbox, the game supports offline play and delivers a pure arcade experience with no ads or microtransactions.
